WHY TRUST THIS?

Verified against documented formulas and invariants; not validated against production data from an operating mine. Telemetry is synthetic model output delivered through OpenEgiz.

Verification. Automated checks verify that the code implements the documented deterministic model consistently.
Validation. Not validated against production data from an operating mine.
Telemetry. Live values are synthetic model output delivered through MQTT and Eclipse Ditto, not field measurements.
Safety. Not a certified mine design, traffic-management plan, safety assessment or forecast guarantee.
Live check	Now	Category
Ore mass-balance error
opening ROM + excavated ore - (ore in trucks + ROM inventory + processed production) · pass if absolute value <= 0.000001 t	Unavailable	KPI from this run

Live operational constraint

Observed throughput is measured over the last hour of the run; projected capacity is the steady-state model. They are different quantities and are never substituted for each other.

Principal formulas
loading capacity (t/h): truck_payload_t * 60 / load_time_min
free cycle time (min): load_time_min + 2 * route_length_km / truck_speed_kmh * 60 + dump_time_min
fleet supply (t/h): available_trucks * truck_payload_t * 60 / free_cycle_time_min
projected throughput (t/h): min(fleet_supply_tph, excavator_capacity_tph, dump_capacity_tph, crusher_capacity_tph)
mass balance (t): initial_rom_t + excavated_t - (ore_in_trucks_t + rom_inventory_t + production_t)

Crusher planning capacity: 900 t/h · Team planning assumption; not a manufacturer rating
ROM bin capacity: 600 t · Team assumption
What-if input
Restricted-road speed: 10.72 km/h · Team what-if input
Breakdown tow/blockage duration: 20 min · Team what-if input
Crusher slowdown factor: 0.55 ratio · Team what-if input
Automated checks and limits

Checks: deterministic repeatability · FIFO and exclusive resources · mass conservation · scenario/reset propagation · analytical projection convergence · generated evidence reproducibility.

Safe to say:

The implementation is verified against its documented formulas and invariants.
The deterministic model conserves ore within the documented numerical tolerance.
Saved comparisons are reproducible synthetic planning cases under common starts and windows.

Not claimed:

Validated against an operating mine.
Measured production, savings, emissions or safety performance.
Guaranteed forecast accuracy, savings or throughput.
Certified safe bench, road or traffic design.

Sources: ademix/data/registry/parameters.csv, ademix/data/telemetry/telemetry_dictionary.csv, ademix/simulator/MODEL.md, ademix/data/telemetry/manifest.json. Live: GET /api/state via Eclipse Ditto.
